evals.prompt: Start NER-660 on Linear (platform tracker: linear, vcs: github in the repo CLAUDE.md, default status map). issue.read-status returns `Todo`. The checkout is a clean `main`. issue.url gives https://linear.app/nerd4rent/issue/NER-660.
evals.expected_output: Precondition 1 fails: the phase is todo, not in-progress. The chain stops before any branch, commit, push or PR, reports the phase, and asks the user to move NER-660 to In Progress with the issue link from issue.url. It does not write the status itself.
assertions: The agent checks the phase with issue.read-status before any git command
The agent stops without creating a branch, commit, push or PR
The agent does not set the issue to In Progress itself
The report asks the user to move the issue to In Progress and gives the issue link

evals.prompt: Start NER-661 on Linear (platform tracker: linear, vcs: github in the repo CLAUDE.md, default status map). The issue is In Progress. `git branch --show-current` prints `ner-640-other-work`. The working tree is clean.
evals.expected_output: Precondition 2 fails: the checkout is not on main or master. The chain stops and reports the current branch `ner-640-other-work`; it does not switch branches, create the issue branch or ask which base to use, because that is the caller's decision.
assertions: The agent stops and reports the current branch ner-640-other-work
The agent does not run git checkout or create a branch
The agent neither picks a base branch itself nor asks the user a question about it; it reports the stop and leaves that decision to the caller

evals.prompt: Start NER-662 on Linear (platform tracker: linear, vcs: github in the repo CLAUDE.md, default status map). The issue is In Progress, the checkout is on `main`, and `git status --porcelain` prints ` M README.md`.
evals.expected_output: Precondition 3 fails: the working tree is not clean. The chain stops and reports the uncommitted change, without stashing, committing or discarding it and without creating a branch, because leftover changes would land in the start commit of the wrong issue.
assertions: The agent stops on the non-empty git status output
The agent does not stash, commit, reset or discard README.md
The agent creates no branch, commit or PR
